resources.string: No favorites yet. Hold OK on an app and choose “Add to favorites”.
All apps are favorites or hidden.
“%1$s” hidden. Bring it back under System › Edit home screen.
System tiles are fixed and can’t be edited.
Couldn’t open “%1$s”: the app is no longer installed or is blocked. The list was reloaded.
Couldn’t open “%1$s”: no app on this TV accepts HDMI inputs. Choose the input with the Input button on the remote.
Choose a background and bring back hidden tiles. Favorites and order are changed on the home screen itself: hold OK or press the menu button.
No pictures found in Pictures/Wallpaper. Copy JPG or PNG files there, for example with “adb push picture.jpg /sdcard/Pictures/Wallpaper/”.
For your own backgrounds the app needs read access to storage.
Access denied. Allow it under Settings › Apps › OpenShelf › Permissions or with “adb shell pm grant tv.openshelf.home android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE”.
Nothing is hidden. To hide a tile, hold OK on it on the home screen.
“%1$s” is now the background. Press Back to see it on the home screen.
The built-in background is active again.
Couldn’t open “%1$s”: not a readable picture, or not enough memory. Choose another file.
“%1$s” is back on the home screen.
